reason: Research was limited: two WebSearch queries (small-cap/Fed backdrop for the week of 2026-10-09; CRWD/DDOG/SNOW/SHOP news) returned no October 2026 coverage for any name in this book and no verified Russell 2000 close for the week. The most recent company items were May-June 2026 and the market items were undated or from August, so I could not tie any recent catalyst to the current marks. Decision rests mainly on the packet. The book is +5.01% versus SPY +3.97%, holds 40% cash, and every leg carries a -12% stop, so the existing risk framework is intact. Without a dated catalyst, trading 10 names and paying full churn costs on a $1,000 book is not justified. Several legs sit near their stops or take-profits (SOFI -6.18%, UPST -3.02%, IWM -1.75%), and I will reassess them next week against fresh news rather than act blind this week.
